description: Hand-reviewed corrections applied after matching (scripts: data/pipeline/build-hospital-dataset.mjs). Keyed by facility id. 'address': null drops a wrong address; 'location': null removes a pin we cannot trust (the facility stays listed as 'location not confirmed' until the hospital sets its own pin in the console). Every entry says why.

pmjay-hosp6g03224.reason: OpenStreetMap addr:full for District Civil Hospital, Sonipat is 'Rohtak' — a wrong label. The pin (28.9908, 77.0362) is the hospital in Sonipat city.

osm-node-7001287193.note: Map location not confirmed: the source address is in Ganaur but the map point was in Sonipat city. Call before travelling.
osm-node-7001287193.reason: Sharma Hospital: OSM address 'Railway Road, Near Vishwakarma Mandir Ganaur' contradicts its pin in Sonipat city (~15 km apart). We cannot tell which is right, and a wrong pin could send someone to the wrong town.
